mapper.sql: s.study_id, s.study_no, s.asset_id, a.asset_cd, a.asset_nm, s.char_id, case when c.char_id is null then null else coalesce(i.item_cd, pr.proc_cd) || '-' || c.char_no || ' ' || c.char_nm end as char_label, c.lsl as char_lsl, c.usl as char_usl, s.method, s.appraiser_cnt, s.part_cnt, s.trial_cnt, s.basis, s.process_sigma, array_to_string(s.appraiser_nms, chr(31)) as appraiser_nms_text, s.study_date, s.status, s.tolerance, s.result_json::text as result_json, s.grr_pct, s.ndc, s.verdict, s.done_at, s.done_by, s.remark, s.row_ver, s.updated_at, (select count(*) from qms_msa_data d where d.study_id = s.study_id and d.appraiser_no > 0) as data_cnt

from qms_msa_study s join mst_phys_asset a on a.asset_id = s.asset_id left join qms_char c on c.char_id = s.char_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = c.item_id left join mst_proc pr on pr.proc_id = c.proc_id

where.if: and (s.study_no ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\' or a.asset_cd ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\' or a.asset_nm ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\')

mapper.sql:
order by
s.study_no a.asset_cd s.grr_pct s.status s.study_date
desc,
s.study_id desc
mapper.select: select study_id from qms_msa_study where study_id = #{id} for update
select asset_id from mst_phys_asset where asset_cd = #{assetCd} and asset_type = 'GAUGE' and use_yn = 'Y'
select use_yn from qms_char where char_id = #{charId}
select asset_id as id, asset_cd as cd, asset_nm as nm, gauge_class as extra from mst_phys_asset where asset_type = 'GAUGE' and use_yn = 'Y' order by asset_cd limit 1000

select c.char_id as id, coalesce(i.item_cd, pr.proc_cd) || '-' || c.char_no as cd, c.char_nm as nm, c.data_type as extra from qms_char c left join mst_item i on i.item_id = c.item_id left join mst_proc pr on pr.proc_id = c.proc_id where c.use_yn = 'Y' order by coalesce(i.item_cd, pr.proc_cd), c.char_no limit 1000

insert into qms_msa_study (comp_cd, study_no, asset_id, char_id, method, appraiser_cnt, part_cnt, trial_cnt, basis, process_sigma, appraiser_nms, study_date, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{studyNo}, #{f.assetId}, #{f.charId}, #{f.method}, #{f.appraiserCnt}, #{f.partCnt}, #{f.trialCnt}, #{f.basis}, #{f.processSigma}, coalesce(string_to_array(#{f.appraiserNmsText}, chr(31)), '{}'), #{f.studyDate}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning study_id
mapper.update: update qms_msa_study set asset_id = #{f.assetId}, char_id = #{f.charId}, method = #{f.method}, appraiser_cnt = #{f.appraiserCnt}, part_cnt = #{f.partCnt}, trial_cnt = #{f.trialCnt}, basis = #{f.basis}, process_sigma = #{f.processSigma}, appraiser_nms = coalesce(string_to_array(#{f.appraiserNmsText}, chr(31)), '{}'), study_date = #{f.studyDate}, remark = #{f.remark}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where study_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.insert:
insert into qms_msa_data (comp_cd, study_id, appraiser_no, part_no, trial_no, value, attr_value, created_by) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{id}, #{c.a}, #{c.p}, #{c.t}, #{c.value}, #{c.attr}, #{by})
mapper.update: update qms_msa_study set status = 'DONE', tolerance = #{tolerance}, result_json = #{resultJson}::jsonb, grr_pct = #{grrPct}, ndc = #{ndc}, verdict = #{verdict}, done_at = now(), done_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where study_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
update qms_msa_study set status = 'CANCELLED', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where study_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
